releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes: ## What's new in 0.2.0 This release hardens the research protocol and ships the evaluation work that came out of comparing this skill against other deep-research skills. ### Sources you cannot open are now handled by rule The strongest primary sources are often behind a paywall or a bot wall. Until now, the right response — record the failure, note the gap, and never pass a snippet off as the original — was implied but not written down. It now is: a blocked page is logged as an observation with its HTTP status, the gap goes into the report as an availability caveat, and a claim whose only support is an unreachable source is labelled `unknown` instead of quietly softened. ### The validator tells you how to fix a failure A failed run used to get a code and a location. releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 33 commits across 3 repos
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu pushed 33 commits across three repositories, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews. In sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu, 16 own commits plus 12 automated commits by github-actions[bot] focused on fixing AI daily-summary failures (deterministic truncation, disabling reasoning so max_tokens no longer consumed by CoT, model-parse fallback, JSON retry, and not skipping when AI is missing), adding AGENTS.md and scripts/daily/verify.mjs, and iterating on typography (Chomsky, Newsreader, 霞鹜文楷, 宋体, 黑体), favicon, per-sentence summary paragraphs, footer notes, and commit statistics that split own vs. automated and exclude merge commits. In sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch, 15 own commits implemented the skill improvement plan (renderer, merge, validator, gaps, genres, docs), listed genre templates in SKILL.md with stop points, added a SenseNova capability gap analysis pinned to 5abde96, made access-blocked handling explicit with validator hints and same-publisher origin warnings, allowed mid-run budget uplift, fixed the middle-path card centering on desktop, applied chapter background alternation to the Chinese main page, localized footer readmes, added brand scroll-to-top, and prepared the 0.2.0 release.

releaseNotes.summary: Hardens the research protocol and ships evaluation work from comparing this skill against other deep-research skills. Blocked sources are now logged as observations with HTTP status, gaps become availability caveats, and claims supported only by unreachable sources are labelled unknown. The validator now also tells you how to fix a failure.

Rolls up v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 with better agent discovery and chain safety. Adds scripts/discover-agents.mjs (read-only, zero-dependency CLI flagging risky fallback chains) and scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs (compact digest of the cached model snapshot). The recommendation table gains a role-overview column.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 33 次提交；发布 meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 与 opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026-10-04，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 33 次，无 PR、issue 或 review。在 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu，16 次本人提交，另有 12 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交，主要修复 AI 日报摘要失败（确定性截断、关闭 reasoning 使 max_tokens 不再被 CoT 占用、模型解析回退、JSON 重试、缺 AI 不再跳过），新增 AGENTS.md 与 scripts/daily/verify.mjs，并迭代排版（Chomsky、Newsreader、霞鹜文楷、宋体、黑体）、favicon、摘要每句一段、页脚说明，以及按 commit date 统计、区分本人/机器人并排除合并提交的提交统计。在 sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch，15 次本人提交实现了 skill 改进计划（renderer、merge、validator、gaps、genres、docs），在 SKILL.md 中列出 genre 模板并标注停止点，新增固定到 5abde96 的 SenseNova 能力差距分析，明确 access-blocked 处理、validator 提示与同源 publisher 警告，允许运行中预算上调，修复桌面端 middle-path 卡片居中，将章节背景交替应用到中文主页，本地化页脚 readme，加入品牌回顶，并准备 0.2.0 发布。在 sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker，2 次本人提交新增 agent-discovery 与 snapshot-summary 脚本，并记录 vision 验证、Windows 刷新路径与 role-overview 列。当日发布两个版本：meld-deepresearch v0.2.0 与 opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0。

releaseNotes.summary: 加固研究协议，并交付与其他 deep-research skill 对比后得出的评估工作。无法打开的来源现在按 HTTP 状态记录为观察项，缺口写入可用性说明，仅由不可达来源支持的论断标记为 unknown。validator 现在还会告诉你如何修复失败。
合并 v1.2.0 与 v1.3.0，改进 agent 发现与链安全。新增 scripts/discover-agents.mjs（只读、零依赖 CLI，标记风险回退链）与 scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs（缓存模型快照的精简摘要）。推荐表新增 role-overview 列。
